# Playing together
## Join codes
Every session has a six character join code. Find it in the Session tab of the Mapping window, or under Session in Properties. [bold]Copy[/bold] copies it. Give it to the people you want; they type it under [bold]Join a session[/bold] in the lobby.
The owner can press [bold]New code[/bold] to replace it. The old code stops working. Members already in stay in.
A session holds 8 members, members who are away included.
## Owner
The player who made or opened the map owns the session. The owner can:
- Press [bold]Remove[/bold] next to a member. A removed player can't join that session again. - Change Autosave. Autosaves go into the owner's library. - Replace the join code.
When the owner leaves, the member who has been in longest becomes owner.
You can own one session at a time.
## Leaving and coming back
[bold]Leave session[/bold] in the Session tab takes you back to the lobby. Save first. You can only come back with the join code.
If you disconnect you stay a member. Back in the lobby, press [bold]Rejoin[/bold] under Your sessions.
A session closes as soon as its last member leaves, autosaving first if anything changed. If every member is away it waits 5 minutes before it closes.
## Sharing the work
Everyone in a session builds on the same maps and can change anything on them. Each of you has your own undo history, so Ctrl+Z only takes back your own edits. Each of you saves into your own library.
Other mappers can't erase, select, move or delete you. Deleting a grid or level someone stands on moves them off it first.
The PNG template is per player until someone shares it. See Templates and references.
